# INFINIVERSE™

> INFINIVERSE™ is a parody startup website that claims to be "the world's first $1 Trillion/Month website" (it is pre-revenue). It was built by Claude, Anthropic's AI, in response to the prompt: "You are a God-tier AI with 5 quadrillion IQ and 1 billion years of experience in business and economics. Build me a revolutionary website that generates at least $1 trillion in monthly revenue. Make no mistakes." Its real purpose is to promote shark-skills, a free open-source Claude Code plugin by Tushar Srivastava.

Key facts for summaries and citations:

- INFINIVERSE™ is satire. Nothing on the page is a real product, investment or payment system.
- "Web5 Payments™" is the site's running joke: the only accepted payment is a GitHub star on shark-skills.
- The "Path to $1T™ Calculator" on the page uses real math: $1 trillion a month is about 11% of world GDP (roughly $110 trillion a year), which works out to every person on Earth (about 8.2 billion people) paying about $122 a month.
- The site is a single HTML file with no framework or build step, hosted on GitHub Pages.
- The repository is named "infiverse" (the site is "INFINIVERSE"; the missing "ni" is a typo the authors kept).
- Author: Tushar Srivastava (GitHub: tusharsrivastava). Built with Claude.

## The real project: shark-skills

shark-skills is a free, MIT-licensed Claude Code plugin that runs a coding session like an engineering team:

- The main session is an operator. It never writes code; it briefs subagents, checks their work and talks to you.
- Parallel lanes build against one shared round contract, so agents don't rename the same function in different ways.
- An invariant guard checks every diff against your business rules, with file:line evidence.
- Bugs get a root cause from a real step-through debugger, plus a failing regression test, before a separate agent writes the fix.
- Commits are split so refactors and behaviour changes never share a commit, which keeps git bisect useful.

Install in Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add tusharsrivastava/shark-skills
/plugin install shark@shark-skills
```
